scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytical argument and exact symbolic plus finite-trajectory checks. Finite computations are not claimed to prove infinite limits. Same-model review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Results are for the deterministic two-dimensional reduced exchange-symmetric double-critical subfamily and fixed positive parameters, not finite fast-cycle four-compartment dynamics or stochastic infection. Parameter-uniform estimates and comprehensive historical priority are not claimed.
title: Three critical extinction phases and a variance-driven logarithmic clock in mixed Beverton–Holt competition
